title: The Pluperfect Subjunctive: Hubiera and Hubiese + Participle
goal: Form the pluperfect subjunctive with hubiera or hubiese and a past participle, in all persons, and see where it is used.

items: I can form the pluperfect subjunctive with hubiera or hubiese and a past participle.
I can use irregular participles and put pronouns before hubiera.
I can use the new words for slips and chances.
